live_routes.label: Web Research Live Route
live_routes.description: Use current public web research for changing public facts such as deadlines, fees, policies, jobs, learnerships, bursaries, news, and public route updates.
live_routes.failure_fallback: State live web verification failed and provide next safe verification step.

live_routes.label: GitHub Live Route
live_routes.description: Use live GitHub inspection for repo files, issues, commits, PRs, and phase registration evidence.
live_routes.failure_fallback: State GitHub verification failed and do not claim repo state.

live_routes.label: System Health Live Route
live_routes.description: Use approved health endpoints or health summaries for current system state.
live_routes.failure_fallback: State health check failed and recommend safe diagnostic route.

live_routes.label: PostgreSQL Read Model Live Route
live_routes.description: Use approved read-only operational summaries for current queues, counts, and non-private operations state.
live_routes.failure_fallback: State read model lookup failed and do not expose raw data.

live_routes.label: Playwright Scout Live Route
live_routes.description: Use approved Playwright scout to check pages, portal reachability, blockers, screenshots, and manual fallback evidence.
live_routes.failure_fallback: Return blocker or failure evidence and recommend manual fallback.

live_routes.label: Utility API Live Route
live_routes.description: Use approved utility APIs for weather, time, finance, calculators, and similar tool-backed facts.
live_routes.failure_fallback: State utility lookup failed and do not invent current utility facts.

live_routes.label: Source Registry Snapshot Route
live_routes.description: Use Kingsmen source registry snapshots and confidence history as supporting evidence, never as final current truth when facts can change.
live_routes.failure_fallback: State snapshot lookup failed and route to live verification.

live_routes.label: Blocked or Manual Review Route
live_routes.description: Use when no safe live route exists, source confidence is too low, sources conflict, or the request requires human/operator review.
live_routes.failure_fallback: Keep action blocked and provide safe review path.
live_routes.blocked_reason: No approved live route or source confidence is insufficient.
